## Change

State the affected client or contract and the required result.

## Verification

List exact commands and outcomes. Separate offline fixture results from any explicitly authorized live test. State unverified behavior.

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation and descriptions are English only.
- [ ] Generated outputs match their authoritative inputs.
- [ ] Applicable offline checks, tests, and strict plugin validation pass.
- [ ] Null/zero semantics and read-only boundaries remain correct.
- [ ] No private source, credentials, personal logs, or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] No unsupported compatibility, identity, license, or publication claim is introduced.
- [ ] No live test, global client change, or publication was performed without separate authorization.
